scientific_integrity: All-infinite-parameter statements are justified analytically. Symbolic and finite computational checks corroborate formulas but do not certify the C^2 central limit theorem. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to one-dimensional order-two randomized interpolation with the specified two-point template, a common uniform shift, two independent uniform residual evaluations per cell, and nonaffine C^2 integrands. It establishes asymptotic distribution, not finite-sample nominal coverage or higher-dimensional analogues. Publication-priority comparisons are bounded by the inspected literature.
title: A universal mixed-normal error law for shared-shift stratified control variates
